It is a clean and hygienic place. Had sent my daughter to Imprints for their summer activities. She absolutely enjoyed being there. Thanks to Miss Riddhi and all the teachers there, they made her really comfortable within a week. The entire setup and Montessori method of teaching also helped calm down my child and concentrate on her activities better.
As truly said a happy child learns better. That's what she did..

featured_reviews.name: Jezreel Pannikot
featured_reviews.review_text:
Qualified Montessori teachers, clean  clutter free learning environment, great push towards the Montessori values. The best school (especially for those looking for Montessori style of education) by quite a margin in this side of the suburbs.

My child loves the time spent in school (which is considerable for his age). And has been showing all-round growth. With close to zero expectations/pressure on parents.

featured_reviews.name: Zalak Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had enrolled for summer camp of two months. It was first time I was introduced to Montessori. It's a beautiful concept. It could see a lot of changes in my child within two months. I am glad I was able to find Montessori near my residence. We are continuing with his preschool here itself.

featured_reviews.name: shruti parikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We came across Imprints Montesorrie sometime last year and were thrilled to have our child visit an offline school. The school follows complete Montesorrie principles which helped my kid get quite independent. Right from chopping vegetables to cleaning after a spill he wanted to do things all by himself which was something I would give Imprints complete credit for.
Been a wonderful experience with imprints Montesorrie till now for us. Keep up the great work teacher Riddhi and teacher Garima!

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: My 26 months old son had the most amazing experience here. Good environment, proper Montessori curriculum with small batch sizes. The best part is you can actually see the difference in the manners and behavior at home.

featured_reviews.name: Nivi
featured_reviews.review_text: Imprints is a true montessori school. There are many other pretending to be montessori but are not. Imprints Montessori is a rare gem to find. The head teacher is very caring. She is very meticulate in designing the course to teach toddlers concepts in the true montessori style. My daughter loved being there and didnt want to go back home.

featured_reviews.name: Hiral Dedhia
featured_reviews.review_text:
The environment is amazing My daughter just loves going to school
It's her happy place

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Tanmayee Sikotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sending my little one to school for the first time was a big step, but Marici made it such an incredible experience. I was so worried about the initial settling phase, but that was managed so well by the teachers and staff.
From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and child absolutely loved it. Seeing him come home so happy and excited confirms we made the right choice.  The staff and all didis here are super helpful. We are so happy with the transition and the care he recieved.
Our journey here has been so beautiful I just can’t say enough good things. As a parent, you want to feel confident that your child is in safe, capable hands, and this school exceeded our expectations. The environment is engaging and the staff is clearly dedicated to the kids. And special thanks to his class teacher Apeksha ma'am for being his comfort zone and making this journey smooth and memorable. It’s been a fantastic first experience for my little one!"
I Highly recommend Marici early learning centre for any parent looking for a nurturing start!

Nice compound with open space for children to run & play.
Also help parents prepare for Higher school selection and prepare kids for child interaction.
